description: Attack the CholeskyQR2 triangular-solve on the low-rank path with a hand-written fused CUDA trsm-as-GEMM kernel. brief-45 refuted ALL torch-level reformulations (explicit-inverse trips fallback; fused-blocked-via-torch has 2+ batched trsms + Ozaki coupling + Bt copy overhead > saving), leaving the trsm at 12-14.5% of shapes 4/8 as the top remaining outer FP32 op. Write a single-launch batched panel triangular-solve that couples the panel back-substitution with 3xTF32 tensor-core GEMM updates in-kernel (no torch-dispatch/alloc overhead, no separate full inverse). Different bottleneck (triangular solve) + mechanism (nvcc) from the in-flight sign/block-eigh and large-n fleet; re-covers the low-rank shapes no active worker holds.
t4: plain-TF32 coupling (TC3X=0) probe - regresses geomean to 35677 (shape3 dense512 orth gate fires -> mass cuSOLVER fallback); confirms 3xTF32 needed for the ill-conditioned dominant Gram

t1: fused single-launch panel trsm, FP32 scalar coupling (1 CTA per item x RT=32 col tile, BS=64 forward substitution). Validates 39/39. geomean 36431 (regression: scalar FP32 coupling ~3x slower than cuBLAS TC-cast trsm; nsys shape8 fused_trsm 35.6%/42ms vs cuBLAS 12.76ms)
t2: register-tiled FP32 coupling (RT=64 BS=64 TN=16, L reused across TN cols). Validates 39/39. geomean 35942 (still regression; SIMT coupling can't match cuBLAS tensor-core casting)

t3: WMMA m16n16k8 3xTF32 tensor-core coupling (Ozaki hi+lo, 3 mma passes) + FP32 diagonal solve. Validates 39/39. geomean 34884 (best so far, still +8.3% vs parent 32197; nsys shape8 fused_trsm 29.6%/31.95ms vs cuBLAS 12.76ms = ~2.5x slower)

t6: barrier-free diagonal solve (per-thread whole-column forward substitution, drops per-row __syncthreads that were 51% of stalls in ncu). geomean 34744. Also probed A-fragment reuse across N-tiles (t5, reverted): regressed to 36478 because 1 warp/M-tile left half the warps idle -- tile-striding all 8 warps busy is better.
t7: RT=32 NT=128 (49KB SMEM -> ~4 blocks/SM vs 2). geomean 34589. Occupancy raised but ncu still 52% barrier-stalled at panel boundaries + diagonal solve underutilizes threads.

t9: nested-block diagonal solve (SMEM-cached BS*BS diag block, 16-row sub-panels, WMMA sub-coupling + tiny FP32 16-row sub-diagonal). geomean 34457, best so far. Also probed BS=128 (t8, reverted): regressed to 35609 (O(BS^2) serial diag solve). Shapes 3(89331)/4(58508)/12(35696) improve; shape 10 k=768(131793) regresses.

t10: no-roundtrip subtract (accumulator loaded from xs, A negated, mma yields B-L@X, stored directly). geomean 34066, best. Removes the 43.5%-of-stalls SMEM scoreboard dep. Shapes 3(89047)/4(58533)/8(102452)/12(35609) all near parent-ish; shape10 k=768(131646) still worst.

t11: RT=16 (minimum WMMA tile width, 24.5KB SMEM -> 5 blocks/SM). geomean 33553, best. Higher occupancy hides SMEM-load stalls; shape10 k=768 115316 (from 131646). Now +4.2% vs parent 32197; per-shape +10-16% (shape3 87790/parent 78451, shape4 58585/50534, shape8 100357/90247).
t12-13: NT thread-count sweep. NT=64 -> 34563 (too few warps), NT=256 -> 33950 (fewer blocks/SM), NT=128 -> 33553 (best, kept). Knob-tuning converged at RT=16/BS=64/NT=128.

t14: removed SMEM diagonal-block cache (D read from global L2 directly). geomean 33205, best. Frees 16KB SMEM -> more blocks/SM. +3.1% vs parent 32197; shape3 84524/78451, shape4 55850/50534, shape8 98267/90247, shape10 114171/104968.

t17: routing window c<=450 (fused only for k=352/384; k=608/768 stay cuBLAS). geomean 32775, best. Shapes 4(50600~parent 50534)/10(104937~104968) recover; shapes 3(84742/78451)/8(98319/90247) still +8% fused. Confirms fused kernel is slower than cuBLAS at every k; the smaller k are closest.

BUILT the fused single-launch batched panel trsm-as-GEMM (load_inline WMMA kernel, HEAD c8f48f3b). MEASURED: it does NOT beat cuBLAS batch_trsm_left on these shapes. Best geomean 32775us vs parent 32197 = +1.8% REGRESSION (39/39 validate PASS, 'stream' absent, zero new fallback -- 3xTF32 matches FP32 accuracy). Per-call: fused ~7.3ms vs cuBLAS ~2.95ms on shape8 rankdef512 k=384 (~2.5x slower); ~5.55ms/call on shape3 dense512 k=352. REFUTATION with measurement: cuBLAS trsm is already tensor-core-cast + well-tuned; a fused trsm alone (already 1 launch) offers no HBM-roundtrip saving, and my kernel is occupancy/barrier-bound (ncu: 18-26% occupancy SMEM-limited, 44-58% barrier/scoreboard stalls) not compute-bound. Confirmed 3xTF32 is REQUIRED (plain TF32 t4 -> shape3 96k->124k mass cuSOLVER fallback). Progression 36431->32775 via: WMMA 3xTF32 coupling (t3), barrier-free then nested-block diagonal solve (t6/t9), no-roundtrip subtract (t10 killed 43.5%-stall SMEM RT), RT=16 for occupancy (t11), drop SMEM diag-cache (t14), route only k<=384 to fused (t17, k=608/768 worst -> kept on cuBLAS). OPEN directions I did NOT reach: (1) FULL-PIPELINE fusion -- fuse Gram(Q^TQ)+Cholesky+trsm into ONE kernel to actually eliminate HBM roundtrips + potrf/bmm launches (the research's real lever; the trsm-only fusion has nothing to save); (2) invert 16x16 diagonal sub-blocks -> GEMM substitution to kill the serial 16-row substitution (the exposed critical path, warp-0-only at RT=16); (3) cp.async/TMA double-buffered X reads from L2 to free ALL SMEM -> much higher occupancy; (4) fuse pass1-trsm output into pass2-Gram. The trsm-only angle as briefed is measured-refuted; the manager may want to redirect to whole-CQR2-pass fusion (a different, bigger brief).
